package.name: aav_camera_stream_rs
package.description: camera_stream in Rust (rclrs): a drop-in for aav_camera_stream's Python node with detector:=none, the default (camera_stream_impl:=python falls back; a detector or decoder:=opencv takes the Python). The same name, topics, QoS, parameters and diagnostics: the camera Pi's RTSP stream decoded by a child program (ffmpeg or gst-launch-1.0), undistorted, and published. The logic is the stream-core crate, with no ROS and no OpenCV.
